name: Brotherly Love
source:
Traumatized upon seeing the death of a loved one with his own eyes, Suihara Tatsuya now irrationally fears the ocean and all of its waves. His younger brother Hayato, on the other hand, views his father's heroic last moments as an inspiration to face challenges head on with all of his heart.
Years later, Hayato becomes the ace swimmer of his school and promises to his dad that he will do his best to bring back his brother into the water. Despite his efforts, Suihara continues to believe that the ocean is nothing more than a death trap that took away his happiness and keeps blaming himself for the unfortunate accident.
One day, the two find themselves stranded on an isolated island with no means of transportation available.
Suihara now has to face the hardest challenge that awaits him…
translation:
水原达也因亲眼目睹亲人的死亡而受到创伤，现在他对海洋和其中的波浪产生了非理性的恐惧。另一方面，他的弟弟隼人则将父亲英勇的最后时刻视为全心全意地面对挑战的激励。
多年后，隼人成为学校的王牌游泳运动员，并向父亲承诺，他将尽最大努力将弟弟带回水中。尽管做出了努力，水原仍然相信海洋只不过是一个死亡陷阱，夺走了他的幸福，并不断为这起不幸的事故而自责。
有一天，两人发现自己被困在一个孤岛上，没有任何交通工具。
水原现在必须面对等待着他的最艰巨的挑战……
